author: SickProdigy
description: Post cached Rocket League schedules, configured tournaments, and random short clips from guild-selected sources.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores guild channels and settings, cached public tournament and clip metadata, configured public creator identifiers, and delivery history. It does not store member data.
install_msg: Use `[p]rlcsset channel #channel` for RLCS updates. Use `[p]rocketleagueset clips` for cached Medal, Twitch, and YouTube clip posting. Provider credentials are documented in the cog README.
name: RocketLeague
short: Cached RLCS schedules, community tournaments, and short clips
